protocol_space.sender: all deterministic source-to-channel-input mappings; optimized exactly for its declared training query prior
protocol_space.receiver: all deterministic received-word-to-four-bit-reconstruction mappings, including duplicate reconstruction outputs
protocol_space.channel: binary symmetric channel with independent bit flips

primary_outcomes: optimal exact average queried-bit accuracy for each query prior, channel budget, and flip probability
frozen optimal protocol accuracy on the other query prior, with min/mean/max across tied optimal indexed decoders
number of decoder maps exhaustively enumerated and number attaining each optimum
predictions: At flip probability 0, the computed frontier must reproduce the exact noiseless n=4 private-query frontier from v0.2.
At flip probability 1/2, all communication budgets and receiver query priors must reduce to chance accuracy 1/2 under the uniform source.
For each fixed noise rate, adding a transmitted bit cannot lower the optimum because an optimal protocol can ignore the extra bit.
analysis_limits: This is a physical bit-flip channel control, not a model of intact text being misunderstood by an LLM.
Only deterministic finite protocols are enumerated; setup, decoder storage, model inference, and transport framing costs are excluded.
The task is an established random access code, not a novel benchmark or language contribution.
Results are exact for the stated finite task and do not establish LLM capability or protocol superiority.
